# Tanzania Hugos Safaris

> Tanzania-based travel company offering safari tours, Kilimanjaro climbs, Zanzibar holidays and day trips.

## Trip information

Published package pages contain the available itinerary, duration, starting price and inclusions where those details are provided. Request a written quotation to confirm availability and the details that apply to your dates and group. Wildlife sightings, migration crossings and summit success are not guaranteed.

The [XML sitemap](https://tanzaniahugossafaris.com/sitemap.xml) lists published public pages and trip content.
